sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《Dealbook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的Dealbook峰会上，现场采访几位商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领导人，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zoran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、佐兰·蒙达尼以及其他许多嘉宾。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 您可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在nytimes.com上直播部分精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果您还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻报道的一个月免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望您能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 您一定不想错过。

sentences.en: It started with a whistleblower's complaint about President Trump's contact with a foreign leader.
sentences.zh: 这一切始于一名举报人对特朗普总统与外国领导人接触的投诉。

sentences.en: Tonight, allegations of a White House cover-up as details of a whistleblower's complaint are revealed.
sentences.zh: 今晚，随着举报人投诉细节的披露，白宫掩盖真相的指控浮出水面。

sentences.en: I had a perfect phone call with the president of Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 我和乌克兰总统进行了一次完美的通话。

sentences.en: Like, I mean perfect.
sentences.zh: 我是说，非常完美。

sentences.en: In that call, the president asked for an investigation of Democratic presidential hopeful
sentences.zh: 在那次通话中，总统要求调查民主党总统候选人

sentences.en: Joe Biden and his son Hunter.
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登和他的儿子亨特。

sentences.en: Today, I'm announcing the House of Representatives moving forward with an official impeachment inquiry.
sentences.zh: 今天，我宣布众议院将推进正式的弹劾调查。

sentences.en: Now the burden is on the Democrats, really, to tell Americans the story of what happened and why it's impeachable.
sentences.zh: 现在，民主党人确实有责任向美国人民讲述发生了什么，以及为什么这构成了弹劾理由。

sentences.en: Good morning, everyone.
sentences.zh: 大家早上好。

sentences.en: This is the second in a series of public hearings the committee will be holding as part of the House's impeachment inquiry.
sentences.zh: 这是众议院弹劾调查系列公开听证会的第二场。

sentences.en: Hey, it's Nick Fandos.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是尼克·范多斯。

sentences.en: I'm a congressional reporter here in the Washington Bureau.
sentences.zh: 我是华盛顿分社的一名国会记者。

sentences.en: Here's the lateSt.
sentences.zh: 以下是最新消息。

sentences.en: The United States ambassador to Ukraine, Marie Yovanovitch, was in Kiev.
sentences.zh: 美国驻乌克兰大使玛丽·约万诺维奇当时在基辅。

sentences.en: We're on our second day of hearings, and we're hearing from Marie Yovanovitch, who was the former ambassador to Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 我们正在进行第二天的听证会，听取前驻乌克兰大使玛丽·约万诺维奇的证词。

sentences.en: And we're seeing basically why these public hearings matter.
sentences.zh: 我们基本上看到了这些公开听证会的重要性所在。

sentences.en: They're not going exactly as the closed-door depositions did before them, and some interesting things are kind of shaking out.
sentences.zh: 它们进行的节奏与之前的闭门作证并不完全相同，一些有趣的事情正在显现出来。

sentences.en: In her time in Kiev, Ambassador Yovanovitch was tough on corruption.
sentences.zh: 在基辅任职期间，约万诺维奇大使对腐败采取了强硬态度。

sentences.en: Too tough on corruption for some.
sentences.zh: 对某些人来说，这种态度太强硬了。

sentences.en: So remember that Rudy Giuliani led this smear campaign, both in the media and with the president,
sentences.zh: 请记住，鲁迪·朱利安尼在媒体和总统面前领导了这场抹黑运动，

sentences.en: to get Yovanovitch removed from her post, which she'd served in under multiple administrations.
sentences.zh: 目的是让约万诺维奇被免职，尽管她曾在多届政府中任职。

sentences.en: And in May of this year, she was removed, even as her boss at the State Department told her she'd done nothing wrong.
sentences.zh: 今年5月，她被免职了，尽管她在国务院的上司告诉她，她没有做错任何事。

sentences.en: And it's only two months later that the president has his July 25th phone call with Ukraine's president, Volodymyr Zelensky, where he pressures him to investigate the Bidens.
sentences.zh: 仅仅两个月后，总统就与乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基进行了7月25日的通话，他在通话中施压对方调查拜登父子。

sentences.en: And so there's this moment in the hearing today.
sentences.zh: 所以，在今天的听证会上出现了这样一幕。

sentences.en: You had left Ukraine by the time of the July 25th call.
sentences.zh: 在7月25日通话时，您已经离开了乌克兰。

sentences.en: When the lead lawyer for the Democrats, Dan Goldman, asked her about that call.
sentences.zh: 当民主党首席律师丹·戈德曼问她关于那次通话的情况时。

sentences.en: When was the first time that you saw the call record for this phone call?
sentences.zh: 您第一次看到这次通话的记录是什么时候？

sentences.en: When it was released publicly at the end of September, I believe.
sentences.zh: 我想是在9月底公开发布的时候。

sentences.en: In the call, the president brings up Yovanovitch twice.
sentences.zh: 在通话中，总统两次提到了约万诺维奇。

sentences.en: The first time.
sentences.zh: 第一次。

sentences.en: President Trump says the former ambassador from the United States, the woman, was bad news.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统说，这位前美国大使，那个女人，是个麻烦。

sentences.en: And the people she was dealing with in the Ukraine were bad news.
sentences.zh: 而且她在乌克兰打交道的人也都是麻烦。

sentences.en: So I just want to let you know that woman was bad news.
sentences.zh: 所以我只是想让你知道，那个女人是个麻烦。

sentences.en: And prior to reading that call record, were you aware that President Trump had specifically made reference to you in that call?
sentences.zh: 在阅读那份通话记录之前，您是否知道特朗普总统在那次通话中专门提到了您？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不知道。

sentences.en: What was your reaction to learning that?
sentences.zh: 得知这一点后，您的反应是什么？

sentences.en: I was shocked.
sentences.zh: 我很震惊。

sentences.en: Absolutely shocked and devastated, frankly.
sentences.zh: 坦率地说，绝对是震惊和崩溃。

sentences.en: What do you mean by devastated?
sentences.zh: 您所说的崩溃是指什么？

sentences.en: I was shocked and devastated that I would feature in a phone call between two heads of state
sentences.zh: 我感到震惊和崩溃，因为我竟然会出现在两位国家元首之间的通话中，

sentences.en: state in such a manner where President Trump said that I was bad news to another world leader.
sentences.zh: 而且是以这种方式，特朗普总统对另一位世界领导人说我是个麻烦。

sentences.en: So I was it was it was a terrible moment.
sentences.zh: 所以，那是一个非常糟糕的时刻。

sentences.en: A person who saw me actually reading the transcript said that the color drained from my face.
sentences.zh: 一位看到我阅读那份记录的人说，我的脸色瞬间变得惨白。

sentences.en: I think I even had a physical reaction.
sentences.zh: 我想我甚至有了生理反应。

sentences.en: I think, you know, even now, words kind of fail me.
sentences.zh: 我想，你知道，即使是现在，我也难以言表。

sentences.en: The next excerpt, when the president references you, is a short one.
sentences.zh: 下一段摘录，当总统提到您时，很简短。

sentences.en: But he said, well, she's going to go through some things.
sentences.zh: 但他说了，好吧，她会经历一些事情的。

sentences.en: What did you think when President Trump told President Zelensky and you read that you were going to go through some things?
sentences.zh: 当特朗普总统告诉泽连斯基总统，而您读到自己“会经历一些事情”时，您是怎么想的？

sentences.en: I didn't know what to think, but I was very concerned.
sentences.zh: 我不知道该怎么想，但我非常担心。

sentences.en: What were you concerned about?
sentences.zh: 您担心什么？

sentences.en: She's going to go through some things.
sentences.zh: 她会经历一些事情的。

sentences.en: It didn't sound good.
sentences.zh: 听起来不像是好事。

sentences.en: It sounded like a threat.
sentences.zh: 听起来像是一种威胁。

sentences.en: Did you feel threatened?
sentences.zh: 您感到受到威胁了吗？

sentences.en: I did.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: This is the moment that Democrats had been hoping for with Yovanovitch's testimony.
sentences.zh: 这就是民主党人一直期待约万诺维奇证词所达到的时刻。

sentences.en: This moment where a woman who was established in her opening statement that she's the child of refugees who fled the Soviet Union,
sentences.zh: 这一刻，一位在开场陈述中表明自己是逃离苏联的难民的孩子，

sentences.en: whose mother grew up stateless in Nazi Germany, who had spent 33 years working for the United States government,
sentences.zh: 她的母亲在纳粹德国长大，且已为美国政府工作了33年的女性，

sentences.en: where she's feeling threatened by the president of the United States, acting in his own personal interest and not the interest of the American people.
sentences.zh: 她感到受到了美国总统的威胁，而总统的行为是为了他个人的利益，而非美国人民的利益。

sentences.en: But then.
sentences.zh: 但随后。

sentences.en: If I could follow up on that question, it seems like an appropriate time.
sentences.zh: 如果我可以跟进那个问题，现在似乎是一个合适的时机。

sentences.en: Goldman is continuing his questioning and all of a sudden Adam Schiff, the committee's chairman, interrupts him and starts making his own point.
sentences.zh: 戈德曼继续提问，突然间，委员会主席亚当·希夫打断了他，开始表达自己的观点。

sentences.en: Mr. Yovanovitch, as we sit here testifying, the president is attacking you on Twitter.
sentences.zh: 约万诺维奇女士，就在我们坐在这里作证时，总统正在推特上攻击您。

sentences.en: It turns out that while Yovanovitch has been testifying about the president, the president has been tweeting about her.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，当约万诺维奇一直在就总统的问题作证时，总统一直在发推特谈论她。

sentences.en: And I'd like to give you a chance to respond.
sentences.zh: 我想给您一个回应的机会。

sentences.en: I'll read part of one of his tweets.
sentences.zh: 我来读一下他的一条推文的部分内容。

sentences.en: Everywhere Marie Yovanovitch went turned bad.
sentences.zh: 玛丽·约万诺维奇所到之处都变得糟糕透顶。

sentences.en: She started off in Somalia.
sentences.zh: 她是从索马里开始的。

sentences.en: How did that go?
sentences.zh: 那里的情况如何？

sentences.en: And as we're watching this, you can actually see Yovanovitch processing it in real time.
sentences.zh: 当我们观看这一幕时，您可以亲眼看到约万诺维奇在实时处理这些信息。

sentences.en: She looks surprised.
sentences.zh: 她看起来很惊讶。

sentences.en: She looks uncomfortable.
sentences.zh: 她看起来很不自在。

sentences.en: She's just been testifying as to how the president made her feel threatened back in September when she first heard about his call with President Zelensky.
sentences.zh: 她刚刚作证说，当她在9月份第一次听说总统与泽连斯基总统的通话时，总统让她感到受到了威胁。

sentences.en: And here it's happening again, as she's testifying on Capitol Hill about that exact thing.
sentences.zh: 而现在，当她正在国会山就这件事作证时，同样的事情又发生了。

sentences.en: But would you like to respond to the president's attack that everywhere you went turned bad?
sentences.zh: 那么，您想回应总统关于“您所到之处都变得糟糕”的攻击吗？

sentences.en: Well, I mean, I don't think I have such powers, not in Mogadishu, Somalia, and not in other places.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我的意思是，我不认为我有这样的能力，在索马里摩加迪沙没有，在其他地方也没有。

sentences.en: I actually think that where I've served over the years, I and others have demonstrably made things better.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我认为在这些年来我服务过的地方，我和其他人确实让情况变得更好了。

sentences.en: Ambassador, you've shown the courage to come forward today and testify.
sentences.zh: 大使，您今天表现出了站出来作证的勇气。

sentences.en: And now the president in real time is attacking you.
sentences.zh: 而现在总统正在实时攻击您。

sentences.en: What effect do you think that has on other witnesses' willingness to come forward and expose wrongdoing?
sentences.zh: 您认为这对其他证人站出来揭露不法行为的意愿有什么影响？

sentences.en: Well, it's very intimidating.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这非常具有恐吓性。

sentences.en: It's designed to intimidate, is it not?
sentences.zh: 这是为了恐吓，不是吗？

sentences.en: I mean, I can't speak to what the president is trying to do, but I think the effect is to be intimidating.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我无法评论总统试图做什么，但我认为其效果是恐吓性的。

sentences.en: Well, I want to let you know, Ambassador, that some of us here take witness intimidation very, very seriously.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我想让您知道，大使，我们这里有些人非常、非常严肃地对待恐吓证人的行为。

sentences.en: So what you're seeing here is some pretty deft maneuvering on the part of the Democrats.
sentences.zh: 所以你在这里看到的是民主党人相当巧妙的策略。

sentences.en: Clearly some aide or somebody sitting behind Schiff saw what was happening in Twitter and started whispering in his ear.
sentences.zh: 显然，坐在希夫身后的一位助手或某个人看到了推特上发生的事情，并开始在他耳边低语。

sentences.en: All of a sudden, he's able to then bring the president's behavior into the hearing room in real time to strengthen the very case that Democrats are making,
sentences.zh: 突然之间，他就能将总统的行为实时带入听证会现场，以加强民主党人正在提出的论点，

sentences.en: to illustrate the same points that they're talking about.
sentences.zh: 以说明他们正在讨论的相同观点。

sentences.en: And very quickly after this happens, the committee goes on break and you already have Democrats talking about what Trump had done on Twitter,
sentences.zh: 在这件事发生后不久，委员会就休会了，你已经听到民主党人在谈论特朗普在推特上所做的事情，

sentences.en: may have just earned him an additional article of impeachment or at least cause for impeachment.
sentences.zh: 可能刚刚为他赢得了一项额外的弹劾条款，或者至少是弹劾的理由。

sentences.en: That in addition to the case for bribery or abuse of power that they're currently making, this may constitute witness intimidation, potentially another impeachable offense.
sentences.zh: 除了他们目前提出的贿赂或滥用职权的理由外，这可能构成恐吓证人，这可能是另一项可弹劾的罪行。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine, until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个严密控制的机器运作，直到今年夏天，选举迎来了一群自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场残酷、混乱，有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在我和莎拉·凯尼格主持的最新一期《Metro》节目中，讲述了人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro, listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《Metro》，在您获取播客的任何地方收听。
